label: copy phase, later positions (recall_idx>=3), echoed token is t/g/o/m
explanation: Fires only during the copy phase (never on original tokens or the <DEL> step), almost entirely from the 4th output onward (recall_idx >= 3 covers 97.5% of activations and 98.6% of mass); activation rate rises with t and L. Inside that window it is selective for the input token being echoed: t (rate 0.31, 34% of mass) and g (0.28, 25%) dominate, then o and m, with a weaker tail on u, h, 2, y, 3, p. The largest activations (max about 0.10) are on echoed t, often right after i. Being copy-phase only, it never fires on the first occurrence of a token in the sequence (in_first=1). Restricting to t/g alone gives precision 0.95 but covers only 58% of mass; the 4-token predicate trades precision (0.76) for coverage (mass recall 0.74). The weak tail of other tokens, and t/g/o/m steps that stay silent for no visible reason, keep F1 near 0.63.
